reviews.text:
Wasted valuable time and energy.

My mother called ahead of time for our oldest dog (11 yr)  who had suddenly lost mobility in her back legs and was in a lot of pain with a chance of permanently losing mobility.

Our family was told to bring our dog to this clinic just for a check in and blood test bill. Then we were told they don’t have the equipment necessary. This clinic then sent us to go to another clinic in YONKERS that ALSO didn’t have the equipment necessary.

After tears and over $2k+ spent transporting between clinics, the Yonkers based clinic then sent us to a clinic in Manhattan…
This was after we made sure that clinic called ahead of time to be sure this last clinic had the right equipment.

To be clear, we’re upset at the lack of direct communication. Why was the Yonkers clinic the next stop? How were we supposed to know what equipment was going to be necessary at the next clinic when it wasn’t communicated to us?

So my best advice is compassion is key when you deal with pets that are dieing one particular Dr is not experienced at being empathetic towards a dieing pet I believe her name is Rita I feel she needs empathy when dealing with clients and try not to simply put dollar signs to get things done we know money with help a certain situation but be more experienced with the parent of a pet especially when the pet is a actually die through poisoning old age or illness that cannot be corrected
Been a customer for more than 25 years

Dr. Roufail is truly the most outstanding vet I have ever met. I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my Max. 🥹💙 He cares so deeply about him as if he were his own and has always been just as supportive and caring toward me as a dog mom. You can genuinely feel how invested he is in Max’s health and well-being. I recommend him to anyone who will listen. Having a vet you trust this much is priceless, and he is worth it every single time. We are so grateful for you, Dr. Roufail! 🐾💙

So far I've only had pleasant experiences with the Vets at Howard Beach animal clinic. They're a little crowded so you may need to wait. However, that's a small price to pay to make sure your fur baby goes to an experienced vet!

Doctor had to Google how to tell a cat’s sex and age… then tried to push a $250 X-ray because I mentioned he sneezed once.
Got mad after I denied the X-ray

"Doctor was knowledgeable, very friendly, and took the time to answer all of our questions. He made us feel comfortable throughout the visit and showed genuine care and concern for our pet. We never felt rushed, and it was clear that he valued both our time and our pet's well-being. Overall, it was a great experience, and we truly appreciated his professionalism and compassion."

Ive been going to this vet for as long as i can remember and i am 35 now. The staff here are extremely sweet and caring. They are very gentle with your fur children and highly compassionate. Honestly words cant describe how well the staff and animal Dr's are they're just that good.

For my first visit I did have to wait but they called me when they were ready to tend to my Max.  There was no rudeness just caring staff from reception area to the assistant and doctor female with caring beautiful blue eyes.  The doctor explained very detailed gave me options with dealing with financial area to give the best care options.  I have to go again tomorrow for his echo and surgery so I will update once I experience more with this place.  For  now though it was a great experience my dog let them carry him and he looked comfortable with them which is a plus. 5/28 he went through his echo and surgery they did a beautiful job, received follow up calls to keep me updated on how he was doing and gave me thorough details.Now to see my Max heal.  Thank you!  They will be his primary vet from now on. Professional, caring, and reasonable.
Would go back in a heartbeat (but hopefully never have to). Professional, kind, and reasonable.
Dr Monaco is a knowledgeable, professional (but friendly) vet who always keeps my pets best interest first. She explains everything clearly without being condescending. Ellie loves her!

I brought my dog in for a dental cleaning at the recommendation of the vet. I’ve been bringing my dog there since a pup for about 7 years.

During every exam, I was told my dog was in great shape and the dental cleanings can be pushed off until he’s older.

At 7.5 years old, I took my dog in during November for the dental monthly special and within 45 minutes of dropping him off, the vet calls and tells me that my dog needs 15 tooth extractions.

Not only was I extremely concerned but upset that all this time, I thought I was taking excellent care of my dog’s teeth only to be informed 1/3 of his teeth have to be removed.

The procedure went from $550 to $1200.
I requested the X-rays and any documentation from the procedure for my records but it’s been 2 weeks and the office staff have me in a holding pattern by saying the dental technicians have to send that file. Every time I call, the office person tells me that “there was no previous note” on file.

I’ll happily share my Verizon phone logs to show how many times I called.

Side note: scheduling and wait times are ridiculous, prepare to standby 30-70 minutes before your actual appointment. I understand we’re dealing with pets and sometimes things take longer than expected but it’s 2021…
Find more staff or a better office management system to track and schedule appointments. At a minimum, provide an update of appointments that will be delayed so folks aren’t waiting forever with scared pets in the office.

Find a different vet if you really care about your pets.

Update 2: took Milo in for his 2nd dental cleaning in February 2026, they found a tumor in his throat, it’s cancerous and he’s being put to sleep this week. What’s the point of going to the vet, keeping all his appointments, spending exuberant amounts of time and money for this outcome.

Super easy to make an appointment, the staff are very nice, and the vets care a lot about their patients. I feel like my concerns are always heard, validated, and cared for by every doctor I’ve seen. (Dr. Tracey, Dr. Monaco, & Dr. Roufail)

They were all amazing, I recommend them. Great care, they clearly love animals.

I will definitely be bringing my pets here in the future, thank you HBAC & all the staff for taking such good care of Athena!
